title: Antenna Array
reference: F1 def F1 { while not wall_ahead { forward if tile_is g { turn_right } if wall_ahead { activate turn_right turn_right } } }
hints: Green marks an antenna. Each one is a different length, with a switch at the end.
One while can walk the whole roof. On green, turn right. At a wall, flip the switch and turn around. Coming back up, the green turns you east again.
F1 def F1 { while not wall_ahead { forward if tile_is g { turn_right } if wall_ahead { activate turn_right turn_right } } }

story.outro: PATCH: "Antennas are jammed. The drones can't get a signal now."
